notes: Data sourced from Financial Datasets REST API for MSFT fiscal Q3 2026 (period ending 2026-03-31, Microsoft fiscal year runs July-June).
Capital expenditures reported as positive outflow from cash flow statement capital_expenditure field ($30,876M).
Free cash flow computed as operating_cash_flow ($46,679M) minus capital_expenditures ($30,876M) = $15,803M.
Free cash flow margin = free_cash_flow / revenue = 15803 / 82886 = 0.190668.
